On or off as an Action. On, the gun is Excellent Quality, but you take −2 to Stealth (−4 against infrared or nightvision). Poor guns still jam on a 1. On an Excellent gun you can paint a target instead (an Action, or part of a shot): until your next Turn, anyone who sees the dot gets +1 to shoot it. Not with a Smartgun Link or Smart Rebuild.

Cost: 200eb (Expensive)
Fits: All Ranged Weapons without a Smartgun Link or Smart Rebuild
